# Hilyah

> Hilyah is an online store for premium hand-stitched genuine leather wallets crafted and shipped from Islamabad, Pakistan. Shop with cash on delivery (COD), lifetime leather warranty, and a 7-day return window.

Hilyah sells bi-fold wallets, tri-fold wallets, card holders, long wallets, and gift sets for everyday carry. Products are genuine leather (no cloth stuffing on premium pieces), handmade, and available nationwide in Pakistan with COD.

Contact: +92 328 5478737 | WhatsApp https://wa.me/923285478737 | Email hilyah967@gmail.com

## How to order

1. Add a product to cart or choose Order now — COD
2. Enter delivery details on the place-order page
3. Pay cash when the parcel arrives (Pakistan-wide delivery)
